Uyilungu leqembu lokuhlela iphephandaba lesikole lesiNgisi. Izaziso ezimbili ngomkhosi ziyahluka komunye nomunye.

x-e-h1-01.title: Icala elilodwa lingenza yini ukuthi kusho 'njalo'?
x-e-h1-01.goal: Embhalweni ophikisanayo, thola umugqa lapho ubufakazi bungasekeli isicelo ngokwanele, ubhale kabusha ube umusho onakekelayo kakhulu, bese unquma ukuthi yimuphi ubufakazi obuningi obudingekayo.
x-e-h1-01.material:
Le ngxenye yombhalo oshicilelwe ephepheni lezindaba lesikole (izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
x-e-h1-01.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha isicelo ukuze sifanele ubufakazi
x-e-h1-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda umbhalo omfushane ophikisanayo wesiNgisi ngezinga leBanga 1 lesikole esiphakeme
x-e-h1-01.prereq.1: Umuzwa wansuku zonke wokuthi 'imbangela' no-'ukwenzeka ndawonye ngenhlanhla' kungahluka
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Kulo mbhalo, yimuphi owokuqala phakathi kwemigqa enesiphetho esikhulu kunobufakazi obunikeziwe emugqeni 2?
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumugqa ngamunye, hlukanisa 'lokho okubikiwe' no-'lokho okuphethwe'.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumugqa ngamunye, bhala eceleni ukuthi umugqa ukhuluma ngomuntu oyedwa, abanye abantu, noma bonke abantu, bese uwuqhathanisa nobufakazi obunikeziwe emigqeni yangaphambilini.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyinkinga. Ukusho ukuthi amamaki "ngokuqinisekile" azoba kabi kubo "bonke abafundi" ngokusekelwe ekwehleni kwephuzu lomfundi oyedwa kuphela (umugqa 2) kuyisiphetho esikhulu kunobufakazi. Ukwehla kwephuzu kungaba nezinye izimbangela, njengobunzima bokuhlolwa noma isimo somzimba. Umugqa 4 unikeza isizathu sohlobo olwehlukile ngamamaki (umsindo, ukukopela), ngakho kumele ucatshangelwe ngokwehlukana kule nkinga. "Ukuvinjelwa kubo bonke" emugqeni 5 nakho kusekelwe kulesi siphetho, kodwa indawo lapho inkinga iqala khona umugqa 3.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi idatha entsha engahlola kangcono ukuthi isicelo emugqeni 3 silungile yini?
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi, uma uqoqa idatha enketho ngayinye, idatha efanayo ingaphuma noma umugqa 3 uphutha.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukuba namacala ambalwa amaningi afanayo kuyazisusa yini ezinye izimbangela.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.a: Imibono yabantu ingahluka ekushintsheni kwangempela kwamamaki.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kuqoqa amacala amaningi ohlobo olufanayo. Akuyikhiphi ezinye izizathu zokuthi kungani amaphuzu alabo bafundi ehle.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Indlela amafoni asetshenziswa ngayo egumbini lokufundela ayibonisi ngqo ubudlelwano namamaki.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.explain: Uma uqhathanisa abafundi abanamafoni nabafundi abangenawo phezu kwesikhathi esifanayo, ungalinganisa ukuthi incazelo ethi 'ngenxa yamafoni' ingcono kunezinye izimbangela yini. Ukuqoqa amacala amaningi noma ukubuza imibono kwenza kuphela isicelo sizwakale siqine kakhulu.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa 3 ukuze ufanele ubufakazi emugqeni 2 (imisho engu-1-2 yesiNgisi), futhi ubhale nokuthi yimuphi idatha eyengeziwe edingekayo ukuhlola isicelo.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umusho owubhalile awuthi kunokuthile okungaphezu kolwazi emugqeni 2 (umfundi oyedwa)?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe umusho ubonisa ukuthi kungase kube nezinye izimbangela?

x-e-h1-05.title: U-'I have a test' ukwenqaba noma cha?
x-e-h1-05.goal: Hlela ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo ukwahlulela incazelo impendulo engayisho ngqo (ukuthi ukwenqaba yini), bese ubhala umyalezo obuza ngaphandle kokubangela ukungaqondi kahle.
x-e-h1-05.material:
Le yimilayezo yombhalo phakathi kuka-Jin no-Hana.

Jin: Are you coming to the study group tonight?
Hana: I have a huge test tomorrow.
Jin: So is that a no?
Hana: Haha, I don't know yet.
x-e-h1-05.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuthi incazelo efihliwe ayimiswanga njengenye kuphela
x-e-h1-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa ulwazi oludingekayo esinqumweni nolwazi olungadingekile
x-e-h1-05.prereq.0: Ukufunda imilayezo emifushane yombhalo wesiNgisi ezingeni lonyaka wokuqala wesikole esiphakeme
x-e-h1-05.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sansuku zonke sokuthi impendulo ingase ingaphenduli umbuzo ngqo
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha konke odinga ukukwazi kakhulu ngakho ukuze uhlulele ukuthi uHana uyeza yini.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ngecala elilodwa lapho impendulo kaHana isho 'angikwazi ukuya' nelicala elilodwa lapho isho 'ngizoya'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funa ekukhethweni ulwazi oluhlukanisa amacala amabili.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.b: Isikhathi sesivivinyo asinalo ubudlelwano ngqo nokuthi uHana uyeza yini.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Inani labantu alisetshenziswa ngqo ekunqumeni ukukhetha kukaHana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Amazwi kaHana angase asho 'angikwazi ukuya ngenxa yesivivinyo', noma 'ngizoya ukuze ngifunde isivivinyo'. Ngakho udinga ukwazi ukuthi iqembu lisivivinyo esifanayo yini, nokuthi uHana unjani uma efunda.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Inhloso yeqembu ilulwazi olubaluleke kakhulu esinqumweni. Kungcono nakakhulu ukubheka nemikhuba yokufunda kaHana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Imikhuba yokufunda ibalulekile, kodwa udinga futhi ukubheka ukuthi iqembu lisivivinyo esifanayo yini.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.prompt: Njengo-Jin, bhala umlayezo ngesiNgisi wokuthumela kuHana (imisho engu-1-3). Imibandela: khuluma ngesivivinyo/ngokufunda, faka okungenani umbuzo owodwa angawuphendula ngaphandle kwengcindezi, futhi unikeze isiphakamiso noma okukhethwayo kokufunda ndawonye.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngezindlela ezimbili uHana angazikhetha (eza afunde, afunde ekhaya).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama uhlaka lwe-'Do you want to ...?' noma i-'If you ..., we could ...'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umlayezo unikeza uHana indawo yokukhetha ngaphandle kokumcindezela?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubuze ngendlela ewuvumela isimo ukuthi sishintshe kuncike empendulweni kaHana?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe empeleni ucela noma utshele ulwazi olukhethe esinyathelweni 1?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ibuze ukuthi isivivinyo siyafana yini futhi yengeza umbandela.

x-e-h1-07.title: Indlela entsha yamabhayisikili yehlisa ngempela izingozi?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Njengoba ubufakazi bengezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, hlola kabusha ukuthi isitatimende sinokholo olungakanani, bese uchaza ngezizathu ukuthi iyiphi inombolo ixazulula inkinga.
x-e-h1-07.material: Lesi yisitatimende esivela endatshaneni yedolobha. "The new bike lane made our street safer." Funda izikhonjo ngokulandelana.
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Ukufunda indatshana emfushane yesiNgisi ezingeni lonyaka wokuqala wesikole esiphakeme
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Ukuqonda kwansuku zonke okwanele ukuhlukanisa 'izinga' ne-'inani'
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho ufunda isikhonjo, hlulela ukuthi isitatimende sisekelwa kahle kangakanani.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi isikhonjo esisha sinikeza esinye isizathu esingachaza inombolo yangaphambili.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa ukuthi inombolo ithi 'mangaki amacala' noma 'mangaki amacala ngabantu abangaki'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kusukela kulesi sikhonjo kuphela, isitatimende sisekelwa kahle kangakanani?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngaphansi kunenyanga efanayo kunyaka odlule kukhomba uhlangothi olufanayo nesitatimende, kodwa kuyinyanga eyodwa kuphela.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Zimbalwa kakhulu izikhonjo ukuze kunqunywe ngenombolo yenyanga eyodwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Sisekelwa ngezinga elithile, kodwa kuyinyanga eyodwa kuphela, ngakho sidinga ukubheka kabanzi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bheka lesi sikhonjo esisha bese ushintsha isinqumo sakho ngesitatimende.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi izingozi zehlile ngenxa yomgwaqo noma ngoba abambalwa bagibele lapho kuna imvula.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Isitatimende sibuthakathaka. Izingozi zingase zehle ngoba abantu abambalwa bagibela amabhayisikili.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uma abantu abambalwa begibela, izingozi nazo zingehla.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda kuze kube isikhonjo sokugcina bese ufingqa isinqumo sakho.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Isikhathi sande, futhi noma inani labagibeli lenyuke, izinga lezingozi lehle, ngakho ubuthakathaka bokuqala bexazululiwe. Kodwa, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi azikho ezinye izimbangela nhlobo.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kwengezwe ukuqhathanisa okucabangela isikhathi sonyaka owodwa nenani labagibeli.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Le datha ayikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi imbangela 'iyodwa kuphela'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Ukholo lwakho lushintshe kakhulu kusikhonjo sini? Sho isizathu ngomusho owodwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Kungani 'izingozi ngabagibeli abayi-1,000' esinyathelweni 3 zingcono ekuxazululeni inkinga yesinyathelo 2?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi yini ngenani lezingozi eyayiyinkinga esinyathelweni 2.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Ngoba kwenza inani lezingozi libukeke likhulu, ngakho liyabonakala
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Inombolo ebukeka inkulu nokuqhathanisa okulungile kuyizinto ezihlukile.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Yizinga lokubala eliguqukile; akusiyo into yokuthi kubalwa izingozi eziningi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Ngoba ungaqhathanisa ngokulinganayo noma inani labagibeli lishintsha
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Uma uqhathanisa kuphela izinombolo, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi izingozi zehle ngenxa yomgwaqo uma abambalwa bagibele. Uma ushintsha kube yizingozi ngabantu abayi-1,000, ungancisha umthelela wenani labantu bese uqhathanisa.

x-e-h1-08.title: Ingabe imithombo emibili ayivumelani ngempela?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Thola umugqa ongalungile esifingqweni semithombo emibili futhi uwulungise, bese ukhetha isenzo esilandelayo sokuxazulula ukuphikisana.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Le yimithombo emibili nesifinyezo somfundi (izinombolo zemigqa yesifinyezo ziqala ku-1).

Umthombo A (izindaba zedolobha, March 3): "The Hanbit Library reopened on March 1 after repairs. It now opens seven days a week, and about 300 people visited on the first day."
Umthombo B (ibhulogi yelabhulali, March 5): "We reopened on March 2. We are open six days a week, closed on Mondays. More than 300 visitors came on our first day!"
x-e-h1-08.prereq.0: Ukufunda izindaba ezimfushane zesiNgisi nombhalo webhulogi ezingeni lonyaka wokuqala wesikole esiphakeme
x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Umuzwa wansuku zonke wenombolo owanele ukuhlulela ukuthi 'cishe 300' no-'ngaphezu kuka-300' kuyahambisana yini
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile esifinyezweni somfundi. (Noma imigqa emibili noma ngaphezulu ingalungile, udinga ukukhetha owodwa kuphela.)
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kumugqa ngamunye, bhala izinombolo noma izinsuku zemithombo emibili eceleni komunye nomunye.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola linye ngalinye ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili zingaba yiqiniso ngasikhathi sinye yini.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 3 no-5 yinkinga. 'Cishe 300' no-'ngaphezu kuka-300' kungaba yiqiniso kokubili, ngakho inani lezivakashi akuyona inkinga yokuphikisana (umugqa 3). Umugqa 5 usho ukuthi omunye umthombo awulungile, kodwa awukwazi ukusho kulo mbhalo kuphela ukuthi ngumuphi ongalungile. Ukuphikisana emigqeni 2 no-4 kuyiqiniso.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi umugqa wesifinyezo oqhathanisa amanani ezivakashi emithombo emibili awulungile, bese ulungisa lowo mugqa, ubhala ngemisho eyodwa noma emibili yesiNgisi. Faka ukuthi amanani ezivakashi emithombo emibili ahlobene kanjani.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kopisha ngqo ukuthi umthombo ngamunye wabili uchaza kanjani inani lezivakashi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala phansi ukuthi u-"about" no-"more than" ngamunye uchaza yiliphi izinga lezinombolo.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kuyaqonda ukuthi 'cishe 300' no-'ngaphezu kuka-300' kungaba yiqiniso ndawonye?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale amagama emithombo emibili (Umthombo A/B) noma izisho zawo ngqo?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ikhombise ngenombolo ethile (310) ukuthi kokubili kungaba yiqiniso.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.prompt: Siyiphi isenzo esilandelayo esingcono kakhulu ukuhlunga ukuthi usuku lokuvula kwakungu-March 1 noma 2?
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi imibhalo emibili ingase yayisekelwe kulwazi luni.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ngomthombo wesithathu ongawuhlola ngaphambi kokukholwa noma yimuphi uhlangothi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.a: Umthombo B wabhalwa ngosuku lwakamuva, ngakho landela u-B ngaphandle kokuhlola ngokwehlukana.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.a: Ukuthi umbhalo wabhalwa kamuva akusho ngokwakho ukuthi usuku lulungile. Udinga ubufakazi obuhlole usuku ngqo.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.b: Thola futhi uhlole irekhodi losuku elenziwe ngosuku lokuvula (njengesaziso).
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.explain: Ukuthola ukuthi kungani izinsuku zihlukile, udinga ubufakazi obuqondile, njengerekhodi elenziwe ngalolo suku. Isikhathi sokubhala noma inani labafundi kuphela akukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi uhlangothi luni olunembile.

x-e-h1-10.title: Ukwenza ingxoxo enqaba isimemo kuyilapho kugcinwa ubudlelwano
x-e-h1-10.topic: Ukubhala impendulo noma ingxoxo efeza imibandela
x-e-h1-10.goal: Bhala wena ingxoxo emfushane yesiNgisi efeza yonke imibandela (ukwala okucacile, isizathu, enye indlela, nokuqonda komunye umuntu).
x-e-h1-10.material: Umngane A umema u-B ukuthi baye ekhonsathini ndawonye ngo-7 p.m. ngoMgqibelo. U-B unomcimbi womndeni ngalobo busuku futhi akakwazi ukuya.
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Ukufunda nokubhala ingxoxo emfushane yesiNgisi ezingeni lonyaka wokuqala wesikole esiphakeme
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Izisho eziyisisekelo ezisetshenziswa uma ungasamukeli isimemo
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela efaneleke kakhulu ku-B yokunqaba?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi u-A, ngemuva kokuzwa impendulo ngayinye, angasho 'ukuthi u-B angaya noma cha'.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: Kucacile, kodwa ithoni yehlisa isimemo somunye umuntu.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.c: U-"I'll try" akacacile ukuthi ukunqaba noma ukwamukela, ngakho kunzima komunye umuntu ukwenza amacebo.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Uma kukhona ukunqaba okucacile (can't), isizathu, nenye indlela (olunye usuku) ndawonye, omunye umuntu akaqondi kabi futhi akulimali kancane. Impendulo engacacile ishiya omunye umuntu elindile, futhi inkulumo eqondile ngokweqile iphazamisa ubudlelwano.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Yenza ingxoxo phakathi kuka-A no-B ngesiNgisi. Qala umugqa ngamunye nge-A: noma i-B:, bese ubhala okungenani imigqa engu-4.
Isimo 1) U-B usho ngokucacile ukuthi akakwazi ukuya (can't, njll.).
Isimo 2) U-B unikeza isizathu.
Isimo 3) U-B uphakamisa olunye usuku noma enye indlela.
Isimo 4) U-A ubonisa ukusabela kokuqonda.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma isizathu (umcimbi womkhaya, njll.) nenye indlela (olunye usuku) kuqala, bese uhlela ukulandelana kwemigqa.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukulandelana empendulweni yokuqala ka-B: faka u-'thanks,' bese usebenzisa u-can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ukunqaba kuka-B 'kuyacaca,' noma akucacile njengo-'try to come'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Enye indlela iyisiphakamiso esingenziwa ngempela (ingabe kukhona usuku noma indlela)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kuhlangabezane nezimo ezifanayo noma isimo siguquke.
